source.notes: Delta-only extraction from the attached 2014 Player’s Handbook, projected for PHB 2024-first character creation. Applicable official PHB 2014 errata is reconciled.

metadata.extractionScope: PHB 2014 delta only — official exceptions retained under PHB 2024 compatibility policy

officialErrata.source: D&D Beyond Sage Advice & Errata — Player’s Handbook (2014)
changesMaterialized: Acolyte of Nature cantrip counts as cleric cantrip and not against cleric cantrips known
